description: This file defines types, interfaces, and global declarations related to embed configurations, styles, themes, layouts, and state management for a booking or calendar embedding system.

methods.name: isEmbed
methods.description: Optional global method to determine if the current context is an embed.

methods.name: getEmbedNamespace
methods.description: Global method to retrieve the embed namespace string or null.

methods.name: getEmbedTheme
methods.description: Global method to get the current embed theme configuration or null.
